high_level_description: The image depicts two human skulls placed side by side on a dirt surface, likely part of an archaeological excavation. The skulls appear to be from the Neolithic period, as indicated by the text overlay at the top of the image. The text reads: "The Lovers of Valdaro – A Double Burial From Neolithic Italy." The skulls are positioned close together, with their faces facing each other, suggesting a possible intimate or symbolic placement.
